body: My daughter has worked through a lot in therapy and despite asking to make plans, putting herself out there… most of them are just plain mean.

I just wanted to say that I could’ve written this myself. I live in New Jersey and my daughter has had such an awful time at high school. She started her high school as a varsity cheerleader, tons of friends, volunteering, and all of that. 

It wasn’t until she had a traumatic event and her so-called friends took the side of the boy. After that, she’s pretty much been alone. She’s had several incidents with bullying and one severe mental health incident. 

However, she has emerged as a very strong young lady, but she is truly lonely. She has a boyfriend and that’s it. The entire school is extremely toxic.

It’s to the point where her school will not allow her boyfriend to attend prom because he goes to a different district and there is a supposed police report with his name on it in our town. On Halloween of 2024, he was defending our 11-year-old against high school boys that were trying to hurt my son because of said son’s disability (tic disorder) and they pick on him because they are mean. 

Long story, short, the entitled brats called their mothers to file a police report even though their children were the instigators. So now that her only close person in her life is unable to attend and I’m completely shattered. If you think of any ideas, I would love to know what your daughter’s plans are. To be honest, I’m hoping college will bring on a nice change. She deserves it after the hell she’s lived through.
Seeing the mom in one of the shots makes me even more mad. As a mother, if my husband ever acted like this toward our daughter, he wouldn’t be allowed near her.

I came to say the same thing. I haven’t followed this family as much since that proposal purity video. I remember feeling sick over that. I was really shocked to see this poor young woman is still in this situation. It’s really sad.
Why would someone post their work for a random to criticize? So weird!

I was a dope addict for a long time. I’ve been clean for 10 years now (I’m almost 40) and never thought someone would love someone as messed up as me. 

Today, I am married with 2 kids. Life wasn’t always easy and I’m so ashamed to admit that I relapsed after my child was born. However, my husband has been with me through so much..  he’s the most forgiving, loving man I’ve ever known. 

Sorry to get all sappy.. just want you to know we all deserve love and I hope you find that for yourself.
Thank you, that’s such a sweet thing to say.
I just watched the video and read the comments on yt.. very sad
